info.title: DSKT API
info.description: DSKT backend contract. Health operations expose no connection details.

post.description: Exchanges a username and password for an HttpOnly session cookie. Invalid credentials return a generic error without indicating whether the username exists.

200.description: Authenticated session with roles and permitted navigation.

navigation.description: Workspace navigation keys permitted by the active roles.

post.description: Creates a provider-neutral application user with a local identity and an out-of-band initial password. The password is hashed; it is never returned.

post.description: Grants Facilities Admin, Workplace Planner, or Viewer. At most one active grant exists per user-role pair; historical grants are retained.

post.description: Reclaims active editor leases owned by a deactivated user so another editor may acquire them.
